titulo: Apple TV makes sign language interpretation a built-in accessibility feature
resumo_original: Apple TV's new accessibility feature lets viewers turn on sign language interpretation within supported titles.

titulo: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
resumo_original: Google's new tensor processing units (TPUs) broaden its chip portfolio to more use cases: confidential model training and more memory capacity.

titulo: N-able takes its remote access service offline after researcher publishes dozens of zero-day bugs
resumo_original: The remote access giant also urged its self-hosted customers to take down their own servers amid a "critical security incident," fearing the possibility of cyberattacks.

titulo: Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS
resumo_original: Users can now interact with Meta’s AI assistant through voice calls, text messages, or dictation on their Apple Watch.

titulo: Reddit is turning user conversations into AI-powered product reviews
resumo_original: Reddit's new AI-powered reviews summarize what users like and dislike about 10,000 products, helping shoppers research purchases ahead of the holidays.

titulo: High oil prices have led to a dip in global carbon emissions
resumo_original: Bucking recent trends, fossil fuel emissions look to be down 0.4 percent.
